{{Quote|Those ships ''knew'' just where to find us&mdash;just like in the Dominus sector.|[[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], to [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]|<ref name="Star Wars (2013) 4">[[Star Wars (2013) 4|''Star Wars'' (2013) 4]]</ref>}}
The '''Dominus sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], inside the region known as [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]], in quadrants T-7, U-7 and U-8. It contained at least seven [[Star system/Legends|star systems]].

==Description==
The Dominus [[Sector/Legends|sector]] was located within the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] region known as [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]]<ref name="TEA" />&mdash;the territory between the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]] and the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]], described as the "cradle of galactic civilization"<ref name="TEA" />&mdash;in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and inside quadrants T-7, U-7 and U-8.<ref name="map" />

The Dominus sector contained the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Baros]],<ref name="GG4" /> [[Dominus III]],<ref name="SW1DH" /> [[Dornea/Legends|Dornea]],<ref name="CTD" /> [[Solanus]],<ref name="Poster">"[[Cantina Communications]]"&mdash;''[[Star Wars Official Poster Monthly 16]]''</ref> [[Solay]]<ref name="SW89" /> and [[Trailia]].<ref name="WEG" /> It also contained a [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] known as the [[Dark Nebula/Legends|Dark Nebula]].<ref name="EAOC" />

At least one [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]], [[Prously's Rim Run]], ran through the sector, linking Baros and Dornea to the neighboring [[Calamari sector/Legends|Calamari sector]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
The tract of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] containing the Dominus sector was explored sometime between the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] of [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]] and the [[Kanz Disorders/Legends|Kanz Disorders]] of c. [[3000 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" /> By [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], it was an established sector.<ref name="map" /> At this time, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Princess Leia]], and [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] scouted out the sector looking for a good place to establish a base. They were [[Mission to Dominus III|attacked]] by an Imperial force and were forced to flee.<ref name="SW1DH" />

During the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]<ref name="TFUCG">''[[The Force Unleashed Campaign Guide]]''</ref>&mdash;a galaxy&ndash;spanning government meant to rectify the problems of its predecessor, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="SWE">{{SWE|groups|empire|Galactic Empire}}</ref>&mdash;the [[Dominus system/Legends|Dominus system]] hosted the ''[[Empirical]]'', a hidden space station serving as the hub for the [[Phase Zero dark trooper]] project.<ref name="TFUCG" /> [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Juno Eclipse/Legends|Juno Eclipse]], the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] of the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Rogue Shadow]]'', was tortured aboard the station and declared a traitor of the Empire.<ref name="TFUCG" />

In [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], Baros was [[Battle of Baros|attacked]] by [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] forces as part of the main effort of his [[Thrawn campaign|campaign]].<ref name="TEA" />

During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], local [[Yuuzhan Vong]] forces made probes into the Dominus sector. [[Dornean Navy]] forces under the command of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Etahn A'baht]] successfully repelled the attacks.<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

By [[137 ABY]], the Dominus sector was within the territory of [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Native species==
===Brubb===
{{Main|Brubb}}
[[File:Brubbgg4.jpg|thumb|left|A Brubb.]]
The [[Brubb]]s were a bipedal [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from the world of Baros in the [[Baros system/Legends|Baros system]]. Their ancestors had adapted to the arid planet plagued by sandstorms by developing a thick skin as well as transparent membranes over their [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] for protection. The howling winds also resulted in the near&ndash;complete loss of their hearing. Baros' high [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] caused the Brubb to be stronger than what their average size of 1.5&ndash;1.7 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] suggested. Brubbs could also change their skin color, ranging from yellow to greenish&ndash;gray.<ref name="GG4" />

Brubbs were a social species, living in communal groups known as [[Haba (Brubbs)|habas]], most of which were extended families raising their children and operating a specialized business together. "University" habas incorporated the best and brightest individuals from other habas, possessing technology comparable to galactic standards, especially in the fields of [[Star/Legends|solar]] and wind power. [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[sentientologist]]<ref name="GG4" /> and [[Xenobiologist/Legends|xenobiologist]]<ref name="GatORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> [[Obo Rin]]'s project ''[[Catalog of Intelligent Life in the Galaxy]]'' stated that one of the university habas made contact with the Empire through the beaming of radio signals.<ref name="GG4" />

===Dornean===
{{Main|Dornean/Legends}}
[[File:EtahnAbaht-CrackensThreatDossier.jpg|thumb|right|Admiral Etahn A'baht, a Dornean.]]
Originating from Dornea,<ref name="CSWE" /> the purple&ndash;skinned [[Dornean/Legends|Dorneans]] were a proud species with a long martial history. Their naval traditions stretched back to the time when the Dorneans were limited to their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld's]] [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]], before their mastery of space travel. The Dorneans were skilled defensive tacticians, particularly [[Gender/Legends|male]] individuals, who held the roles of caring for children.<ref name="CTD" />

During the reign of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], the Dorneans [[Dornea's war against the Empire|repulsed]] the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] with a minimal fleet of their own. The Dorneans eventually joined the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="CTD" />

===Trailian===
{{Main|Trailian}}
The [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Trailian]]s evolved on the planet Trailia and possessed a peaceful, low&ndash;technology society by the time of the New Republic,<ref name="WEG" /> a government reformed from the [[Alliance of Free Planets]] previously existing as a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|rebel organization]].<ref name="TEA" /> [[Cronal]], one of Emperor Palpatine's [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] servants, discovered the world after [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]] and established a [[Cronal's laboratory|laboratory]] inside Trailia's jungles, capturing native Trailians and transforming them through genetic engineering and dark side experimentation into a race of [[Trailian sithspawn|warriors]] he intended to use against the New Republic. He dispatched some of the warriors to raid other planets, which prompted the remaining Trailians to offer a reward for an investigation, thus attracting a group of offworlders to Trailia.<ref name="WEG" />
{{RPG}}
A Force-sensitive member of the team detected the dark side signature of Cronal's [[Laboratory/Legends|laboratory]] and led the group there. In an [[Battle of Trailia|engagement]], they defeated the mutated Trailians and other beasts guarding the fortress, but Cronal escaped the battle along with some warriors that continued razing offworld cities before being tracked down and eliminated by the same team.<ref name="WEG" />
{{Endgame}}
